component: Mailbox protocol unit-test coverage and diagnostics

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Removing the nsIMailboxUrl QI leaves a smoke test for protocol metadata and URI spec. The newChannel check is still commented out with a Windows-failure note, so this task does not exercise the protocol’s new concrete receiver access. The URI-spec assertion and the other four assertion sites also have no failure messages. A focused repair should add nonempty expected-behavior messages containing should; these omissions predate the interface cleanup. No test ran.
title: The mailbox protocol smoke test checks metadata and URI text without opening a channel
